verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party evidence of a unified view of assigned tasks pulled from multiple project management tools. The GitHub sync integration covers only one non-PM tool and never mentions assigned tasks. "One system of record" is marketing copy, and the REST API, webhooks and MCP are developer building blocks someone could use to build such a view, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
